results.overview: Alter Yellow is a series produced by CAV Brequigny. The concept is simple: Each episode has a cinematic genre (comedy, drama, thriller, etc.) but with one common element: the presence of a yellow camcorder in each episode. In this second episode, the yellow camera filmed a murder, Inspector Noé Morcati, also known as Inspector Moutarde, needs this evidence to solve the investigation
